package domain

import "testing"

func TestCompletionPolicyValidation(t *testing.T) {
	valid := []LessonActivity{{ActivityID: "f8eb1ac2-80d3-4515-85ac-cf592fc572cb", Type: ActivityPracticeCompleted, Required: true, SourceReference: ActivitySourceReference{ID: "04266929-9801-4883-b664-58fe5ca1ef54", RevisionID: "04266929-9801-4883-b664-58fe5ca1ef54"}}}
	if err := ValidateLessonActivities(valid); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	invalid := append(valid, valid[0])
	if ValidateLessonActivities(invalid) == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate activity accepted")
	}
	valid[0].ActivityID = "f8eb1ac280d3451585accf592fc572cb"
	if ValidateLessonActivities(valid) == nil {
		t.Fatal("noncanonical UUID accepted")
	}
	valid[0].ActivityID = "f8eb1ac2-80d3-4515-85ac-cf592fc572cb"
	valid[0].SourceReference.RevisionID = "a4266929-9801-4883-b664-58fe5ca1ef54"
	if ValidateLessonActivities(valid) == nil {
		t.Fatal("mismatched practice revision identity accepted")
	}
	valid[0].SourceReference.RevisionID = ""
	if ValidateLessonActivities(valid) == nil {
		t.Fatal("unpinned practice accepted")
	}
	valid[0].SourceReference.RevisionID = valid[0].SourceReference.ID
	valid[0].Required = false
	if ValidateLessonActivities(valid) == nil {
		t.Fatal("policy without required activity accepted")
	}
}
